<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Reviewing all 57 commands to identify which ones to keep. `drive.md` looks useful because it mirrors the three-tier PM system and is repo-specific.

`note.md` is useful since it references the existing `NOTES.md`. `architecture-review.md` and `directory-deep-dive.md` could still be worth keeping. `drive.md` overlaps with existing skills. `todo.md` conflicts with the three-tier system. `add-to-research.md` points to a non-canonical `RESEARCH_QUEUE.md`.
